body: GO-writing lesson (Opus2, 2026-11-19, 1AAD-EXACT-2 leg 4). TermAl's scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused mode runs the given command at the REPOSITORY ROOT (focused stage cwd = request.root), whatever directory the launcher is started from. So a GO that says "cwd ui: npx tsc --noEmit" runs npx at the root, where ui's node_modules is not on the path, and npx fetched and executed the unrelated registry package tsc@2.0.4 (a deprecated placeholder) on DL560. Rules for UI legs: never use npx in a GO; call the local binaries by path from the repository root, for example node ui/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p ui and node ui/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ui FILES..., after an isolated npm ci in ui. Treat a run made under a wrong procedure as INVALID PROCEDURE evidence, not a product result.
